Inside the candy shop, the green dinosaur car nodding politely while a friendly shopkeeper vehicle gestures toward a tiny toothbrush, warm reminder mood
The green dinosaur car in a cozy garage at night, sleepy half-closed eyes glancing between a toothbrush cup and a fluffy pillow, drowsy conflict mood

scenes.summary: 照鏡子發現黃牙與大笑比賽
scenes.prompt: The green dinosaur car looking shocked in a round mirror showing yellow stained teeth, a festive laugh contest banner in the amusement park background, anxious mood
A bright red race car inviting the green dinosaur car to join fun, but the dinosaur car keeps mouth tightly closed and looks worried, contrast of joy and shyness
The cream-and-green street sweeper truck kindly talking to the embarrassed green dinosaur car on a quiet park lane, gentle caring friendship mood

The street sweeper truck gently pointing at a large simple educational poster: one neat U-shaped row of evenly spaced cartoon teeth in correct order (no extra teeth, no crooked gaps), left half sparkling clean white, right half same neat row with soft yellow sticky spots for plaque, side-by-side comparison, friendly teaching mood, no realistic dental horror
The green dinosaur car looking relieved and hopeful, nodding while the street sweeper truck smiles encouragingly, warm sunrise hope mood

The street sweeper truck holding up a cute illustrated bedtime-brushing mission card with exactly two big numbered pictograms: (1) drink water and rinse mouth after eating sweets — cup of water icon, (2) remember to brush teeth before sleep — toothbrush with moon and stars icon, child-friendly checklist not a chalkboard or dental chart, the green dinosaur car listening in a cozy garage
The green dinosaur car brushing teeth diligently with foam bubbles like little white clouds, determined focused expression, bright clean bathroom mood
The green dinosaur car smiling at a mirror with much cleaner teeth, fresh minty feeling, proud relieved mood

scenes.prompt: The green dinosaur car brushing teeth at night even when tired, visible mouth showing bright sparkling shiny white teeth behind gentle foam bubbles, little yawn but determined, cozy bedtime routine mood

scenes.summary: 一週後大笑比賽大方微笑
scenes.prompt: The green dinosaur car laughing openly at the amusement park laugh contest, mouth wide with bright sparkling shiny white teeth clearly visible, big happy smile, friends cheering, bright celebratory mood

The green dinosaur car with the exact same wide happy laugh and same bright white teeth as the laugh contest scene, mouth open smiling just like scene 20, now at soft starry night in the amusement park waving one wheel goodbye to children, moonlit cozy night mood, encouraging warm farewell
